result.title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
result.summary: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReCoRain，一个事件引导的残差视频扩散去雨框架：用 RGB 外观、事件区间证据和前向−后向运动一致性共同评估帧间对应可靠性，并据此分别门控相邻内容特征聚合与 latent 序列初始噪声的共享，训练与推理采用相同的条件噪声构造。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可靠性门控」同时约束视觉内容迁移与 latent 序列噪声相关性，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、跨帧状态更新的可靠性与 latent 相似度受噪声构造影响等问题提供可核查的方法线索，但本身不涉及多模态推理。
